{{Top|leg}}
The '''PK-2M mining droid''' was a model of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that existed during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Thaarke Corporation]] used some to push ore carts in the [[Geddis mine]], on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].
